subject: Meridian Logistics — invite bounceback: org mapping prevents Coupa login
messages:
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@meridianlogistics.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@meridianlogistics.com
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Coupa invite acceptance fails — 'Organization not found'

Hi Priyom,

We received the vendor invite yesterday but several of our finance users get redirected to a Coupa login error when they try to accept. The page shows: 'Organization not found / org key missing' and asks them to contact the portal admin. We've tried clearing cookies and different browsers; same result.

This is blocking our ability to receive POs from Redwood — we have an urgent PO hold for a shipment scheduled next week. Can someone resend or advise a workaround? I attached a screenshot of the error.

Att: meridian-sso-error-screenshot.png (PNG screenshot of Coupa page showing 'org key missing')

Thanks,
Sarah Jennings
Procurement Manager
Meridian Logistics
(sarah.jennings@meridianlogistics.com)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@meridianlogistics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coupa invite acceptance fails — 'Organization not found'

Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick note and the screenshot. Sorry you're hitting this.

Quick checklist while we look into it:
- Try accepting the invite in an incognito/private window (helps rule out stale cookies).
- If possible, have one user try from a different network (home/mobile) in case of a proxy rewrite.

I'm looping in Ben from the onboarding team and Lauren from procurement ops to take a look at the Coupa tenant mapping. If needed we can generate a fresh invite bound to your tenant org id.

If this blocks the PO timeline, please confirm whether we have permission to create the vendor record manually so payments won't be delayed.

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@meridianlogistics.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coupa invite acceptance fails — 'Organization not found'

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the detail. From the symptoms this looks like an org-mapping mismatch: your users are hitting our invite link but Coupa is resolving to a different tenant (missing the org_key). I just performed two things:

1) Generated a new tenant-scoped invite (attached) that pins the org_id to Meridian's tenant. Please try that one first.
2) Pushed a short troubleshooting doc to our shared Drive with the most common SSO failure modes: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMeridian-invite-troubleshoot

Attached: Meridian_Coupa_invite.eml — this is the regenerated invite. When you test, please use an incognito window and open the invite directly rather than clicking through redirects. If your IdP is enforcing a different relayState it can cause the redirect to drop the assertion.

If that still fails, please confirm one test user (email) and approximate timestamp — we can pull auth logs from the Coupa tenant and correlate.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Onboarding Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@meridianlogistics.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@meridianlogistics.com
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coupa invite acceptance fails — 'Organization not found'

Hi Ben / Priyom,

Thanks — we tried the regenerated invite exactly as you described (incognito + direct open). Unfortunately the flow still bounces us to the SSO page with a short error: 'No SAML assertion received'. The user we tested with was alice.walsh@meridianlogistics.com at ~11:08 PST.

I attached the latest screenshot showing the SSO error page. Our IdP team says they see an inbound auth attempt but no SAML payload, which suggests the relay/redirect is dropping parameters somewhere.

Att: meridian-sso-error-screenshot.png (updated)

This keeps the PO on hold — can you escalate to the Coupa tenant admin or engineering to get auth logs?

Sarah
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
